parsed.explanation: The quoted line appears verbatim under "Approaches tried" and the Status is "partial"; the "Full proof" section reads "(in progress)". The text's own reduction (Theorem A: the sequence equals S_inf ∩ [a_1,∞)) makes periodicity depend on S_inf being a union of residue classes mod L, which the write-up says requires that H_n stabilizes / S_inf be finitely generated — exactly the finiteness / large-prime-erasure obligation (F). Nowhere in the text is this proved for all cases: it is supported only by empirics ("100+ values of a_1 ... verified") and labelled "Remaining crux" and "Proof of that lemma is in progress". Hence the translation identity a_{n+T}=a_n+L is not established, and the gap is essential, not repaired elsewhere.
